main_body: Large wooden crate (with a smaller crate stacked at right): a plank-striped lid above a dark brown front face with a diagonal brace
top_band: light tan horizontal plank bands, rows ~1-8, ending in a lighter front-edge row, then an abrupt step to dark brown
evidence: Reading a column through the middle of the large crate: tan lid planks (rows ~1-8), a distinct light front edge, then a dark brown shadow row at ~9-10 and the front face with its diagonal brace down to ~19, then a dark base. The lid is a clearly visible horizontal surface that is several rows tall, and the front face is also clearly drawn. The diagonal brace is painted flat rather than inset, but the top, edge and eave shadow are all present.

style.evidence: The lid has about 3 tan tones in simple horizontal stripes, and the front face is a large flat dark brown area with a single lighter diagonal brace line and almost no grain or speckle. Outlines are tinted dark brown, which is fine. Overall the crate has fewer shading steps and much less per-tile detail than the stall and well references, so it looks thinner and flatter next to them.
